<div class="card-body">
'''Rogue Gunner''' is a [[Light]] [[Character]] ([[Rebel]]) from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ローグ砲手</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">乗客として宇宙船に乗っているなら、その宇宙船の兵器の武器運命数に1を加える。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Rogue-Gunner-PSA-89232343.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">コルサント出身のケシン・オムニスに代表される砲手たちは、ビークルや宇宙船の後部砲塔の操作を担当する。高度な訓練によって兵器の扱いに精通している。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Rogue Gunner.

'''Card text:'''
If aboard a starship as a passenger, add 1 to that starship's weapon destiny.

'''Lore:'''
Gunners such as Kesin Ommis from Coruscant operate aft turrets on vehicles and starships. High training has made them skilled with weapons.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Game text adds その宇宙船の兵器の (that starship's weapon's) before weapon destiny.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Rogue Gunner]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
